tasks.final_text: Where I work we've embraced remote work. So many teams include remote employees. Because of this, it's hard to build teammwork or simulate the other bonds that come with "water cooler" talk. One way we help mitigate this problem is by having a "daily question" we include in our daily standup meeting. One of my go-to questions is: If you could eat one food the rest of your life what would it be? My answer?Lagana(Ican'tseemtotypespaceanymore.Gointoleaveithere.)

Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the coporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease fo rthe entire building in 2020.
